name: Kiptenden Youths Bot
description: Kiptenden Youths community WhatsApp bot for information, engagement, and group support

SESSION_ID.description: Your WhatsApp session ID. Generate it with the included pairing page.

MODE.description: Bot mode: 'public' (everyone can use) or 'private' (only bot owner)

AUTO_LIKE_STATUS.description: Auto-like WhatsApp statuses. Set true or false.

AUTO_READ_STATUS.description: Auto-view WhatsApp statuses. Set true or false.

DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection URL. Leave blank to use auto-provisioned Heroku Postgres, or supply your own (Neon, Supabase, etc.). Falls back to SQLite if empty.

BOT_EXPIRY_DATE.description: Optional expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave blank for an always-active bot.

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Owner or administrator WhatsApp number in international format, without the plus sign
